name: sfx_peripherals
description: ScaleFX peripheral drivers — PwmOutput concept (single pin-level abstraction) with two backends (NativeGpio, PCA9685), LED control + multi-channel manager templated on PwmOutput, servo output, PWM input, INA226 power monitoring + Sensor concept, battery monitor, I2C device base class, DC motor + StallDetector, multi-channel collection facades (servo / PWM / LED) with C++20 concepts (SensePolicy, PwmLedSink).
